# Code of Conduct

Knemora contributors are expected to make participation respectful, safe, and constructive.

- Treat people with empathy and respect across differences in experience and background.
- Critique ideas and code, not people.
- Do not harass, threaten, discriminate, publish private information, or use sexualized language.
- Assume good intent while accepting clear correction when an interaction causes harm.
- Keep technical discussions relevant and make room for less experienced contributors.

Project maintainers may edit or remove contributions and restrict participation when behavior
violates these expectations. Report conduct concerns privately through the repository owner's
GitHub profile. Reports will be handled as confidentially as practical.
